name: Jelly-Request
description: Scrape IMDb's Most Popular Movies and automatically request them in Jellyseerr, ideal for keeping your media library up-to-date on Unraid.

paths.name: Log Path
paths.description: Path to store log files on the host

variables.name: Jellyseerr URL
variables.description: URL of your Jellyseerr instance (e.g., http://192.168.0.29:5054)

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Jellyseerr API key (found in Jellyseerr settings)

variables.name: IMDb URL
variables.description: IMDb chart URL to scrape. Default: Most Popular Movies. For other languages/regions, use URLs like: French movies: https://www.imdb.com/search/title/?title_type=feature&primary_language=fr&sort=popularity,desc | Indian movies: https://www.imdb.com/india/top-rated-indian-movies/ | Top 250: https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/ | Any valid IMDb list URL works!

variables.name: Movie Limit
variables.description: Number of movies to scrape from IMDb (default: 50)

variables.name: Enable 4K Requests
variables.description: Enable 4K quality requests in Jellyseerr. Set to 'true' for 4K or 'false' for standard quality (default: true)

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Logging mode: SIMPLE for minimal logs, VERBOSE for detailed logs (default: SIMPLE)
